run 10 — Part A1, PR #137. Run 9 exposed one more false rejection:
"Bhagavad-gita 6.6" spelled out contains no literal "bg", so the correct
constraint "Bg 6.6" still read as invented. Book names written in full
now map to their siglum for that check only — not for retrieval, which
is a separate change on separate evidence.
